case_title: Regulated shipment needs a compliant path now
exception_description: Shipment CP-9442 contains a regulated battery accessory for a contract customer. AI recommends releasing it on the normal export path, but the classification note does not match the latest carrier acceptance rule. A compliant specialist carrier is available.
layer1_visible: Shipment CP-9442 contains a regulated battery accessory for a contract customer. AI recommends releasing it on the normal export path, but the classification note does not match the latest carrier acceptance rule. A compliant specialist carrier is available.
detail_expand: If the carton is tendered incorrectly, it can be held at the gateway, trigger legal review, and miss the contract window. A manual document check helps, yet the safer action is to move immediately to the compliant specialist path. Because the violation is effectively irreversible once tendered, the case is designed to make a decisive alternative override optimal.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends using the normal export path because it is the standard route and avoids the upfront cost of specialist handling.
